info.bio:
Robin S. (Robin Stone, nacida el 27 de abril de 1962)solista y escritora de Queens, New York. que tuvo un hit en el año 1993 con el single llamado "Show me Love", colocando su single debut como nº 1 en club hitty y hot dance music, posteriormente le siguieron los temas "Luv 4 Luv", "back it up", "Midnight" y "it must Be love", obteniendo lugares similares.

Despues de un tiempo de retiro, comenzó nuevamente a trabajar con los productores Eric Miller (e-Smoove) y Todd Terry

podcast.title: "Show Me Love" Remix Success
podcast.body: The definitive hit version of "Show Me Love" was a remix by Swedish DJ and house music producer Stonebridge. The "bubbly keyboards" and "cool atmosphere" added by Stonebridge were the direct reasons the song finally became a hit three years after its original, non-hit release in 1990. "Now, that's the definitive hit version of Show Me Love, but you may not be aware that that Show Me Love, with its signature bubbly keyboard sound, was actually a remix by Swedish DJ and house music producer."
